svg.title: Sumac Study
svg.desc: Hand-authored interpretive SVG after direct visual inspection of the cited primary reference. Approximate contours and standardized vivid colors; paint texture, photographic perspective and external framing omitted. Primary Peter Freeman 2005 PF0898 photograph: orange-on-orange asymmetricX, with two distinct default shades in one editable orange family. The small 24 × 20 inch Sumac Study is distinct from the 188 × 160 cm Sumac; physical aspect follows actualcaption.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://www.peterfreemaninc.com/exhibitions/ellsworth-kelly/selected-works?view=multiple-sliders; record freeman:PF0898; visual review 2026-10-27. Pure-vector study; not a facsimile.
